plan.name: Check plans against existing tests
plan.summary: Add explicit instructions to the plumbing planning prompt for both drafts and revisions so ratified plans account for existing tests. Before naming files, the planner must inspect tests and fakes that check changed behavior, including command lines, flags and output, and name every existing test file the change needs. Acceptance expectations about behavior the plan keeps must agree with the tests that pin it; an intentional change to pinned behavior must be stated in the summary and name those existing tests in the files. Preserve the other planning instructions and keep the existing internal/formalize tests passing. Whoever merges records this planning clarification as a decision resting on D-0105 and D-0107.

tests.name: TestPlanningNamesExistingTestsForChangedBehavior
tests.says: Draft and revision prompts tell the planner to inspect existing tests and fakes for changed behavior before naming files, including command lines, flags and output, and to name every existing test file the change needs.

tests.name: TestPlanningKeepsAcceptanceConsistentWithPinnedBehavior
tests.says: Draft and revision prompts require acceptance expectations for preserved behavior to agree with existing tests, and require intentional changes to pinned behavior to be stated in the summary with the existing tests named in files.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and two acceptance tests covering both requested planning instructions, leaving `repo/` unchanged. The plan passed check 1 of 4; a separate baseline test run encountered sandbox socket-binding restrictions.
